metrics.name: CodeBLEU similarity to reference
metrics.construct: Surface and structural similarity between the generated solution and a golden reference
metrics.denominator: candidates whose case has a golden reference
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable for every case without a reference bundle

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures; ordering properties tested against renamed, restructured and unrelated candidates

metrics.limitations: three of the four original components are implemented as specified; the data-flow term is replaced by an explicitly named variable-usage match, because a real data-flow graph needs name resolution this analyser does not perform

metrics.name: Structural edit distance to reference
metrics.construct: Zhang-Shasha ordered tree edit distance between the candidate's and the reference's structure trees
metrics.denominator: candidates whose case has a golden reference
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable for every case without a reference

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: a bracket-structure tree with normalised identifiers and literals, not a parsed AST; it is blind to renaming by design, which is why it is reported alongside reference.codebleu rather than instead of it

metrics.name: Golden tests on generated solution
metrics.construct: Share of the golden test suite the generated solution passes
metrics.denominator: golden test cases for that case
metrics.limitations: golden tests are sealed suite assets, so this metric requires an isolated backend that can combine them with the candidate

metrics.name: Generated tests on golden solution
metrics.construct: Share of the generated test suite the golden solution passes
metrics.denominator: generated test cases for that candidate
metrics.limitations: requires an isolated backend that can combine the candidate with sealed reference assets

metrics.name: Statement embedding similarity
metrics.construct: Semantic similarity between the generated and reference problem statements
metrics.denominator: candidates whose case has a golden reference
metrics.limitations: no embedding model is configured, and embedding similarity would be a weak semantic signal even if added
